messages.author: fd2fc7e46319d1dd
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: shiny app not automatically resizing on mobile
parts:
Hi all,

I had the same problem and I unfortunately haven't found a way to do it directly with a shiny option but you can use this piece of code (which works perfectly well for my shnyashboard app) :

tags$head( 
   tags$meta(name = "viewport", content = "initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no, width=device-width")
)

HTH ! :)


Best regards,


-- Aline
